description_en: Queries the status of cloud platform authorization information for a user
description_zh: 查询用户云平台授权信息的状态
name: DescribeUserBaselineAuthorization

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for requests and responses. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

UserBaselineAuthorization.description_en: The authorization information for cloud baseline configuration check
UserBaselineAuthorization.description_zh: 云基线配置检查授权信息

Status.description_en:
The authorization status of the cloud platform configuration check. Valid values:
0: Authorization is disabled. If authorization is disabled, you cannot use the cloud platform configuration check feature.
1: Authorization is enabled. If authorization is enabled, you can use the cloud platform configuration check feature
Status.description_zh:
云平台配置检查授权状态。
0：授权关闭。授权关闭的状态下，您无法使用云平台配置检查功能。
1：授权开启。授权开启的状态下，才可以使用云平台配置检查功能
